PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Regain foundational strength and mobility postpartum"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Gentle Recovery" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Gentle Mobility & Walking":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x20s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Thursday training 25m "Gentle Mobility & Walking":

          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
